Fist Hadenwell is a human Flaming Fist in Act Two. He can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.

Involvement

Act Two

If  Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and once the  Nightsong has been freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers, Hadenwell, along with the Flaming Fists  Helena,  Nipawa,  Rhed and  Ulthred survives the first assault and assists the party in the remaining battle against the Absolute forces.

After the battle, provided she survives, she and the remaining Flaming Fists scout the Moonrise Towers Prison and enter a second battle against the Myrkulites  Duckie Verish,  Sarabayle, and  Willinx Jindlebee, as well as a Death Shepherd and a horde of Necromites. The party can assist the Fists in this optional battle. If the Fists survive, they guard the prison until  Ketheric Thorm is defeated.

After Ketheric Thorm is killed and the party leave for Act Three, Hadenwell disappears from the game entirely.
